description: Write one driver in a format other tools read, any of the formats of osd-formats: 'oscquery' gives its OSC namespace as OSCQuery JSON (every route with type tags, ranges and access, for OSC controllers and browsers); 'midnam' gives its MIDI names as a MIDI Name Document (controllers incl. NRPN/RPN, named values, drum notes per channel, for DAWs such as Ardour or Logic); 'deluge' gives the definition file of a Deluge; and the others in the enum. Each carries the credit and licence of the driver's sources. The document is the text content; an OSCQuery namespace is large (every address, each CC 0-127 included). It only reads: it never writes to a device.

device.description: Driver id (e.g. 'korg/minilogue') or slug, from list_devices.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: export_device

bytes.description: Size of the document, which is the text content.

file_name.description: A file name to save it under.

media_type.description: The media type of the format (e.g. 'application/json', 'application/xml').
